_note: The SpeedKills world's own numbers, whatever map it is on (src/game/world.ts, br.ts, edge.ts, padsolve.ts, atmosphere.ts): they lived in city.json with the old ILranch city's, which the owner had taken out on 2026-10-09 ("remove ILranch city completely"). The Neon City sets its sectors, its Spire top and its own air as it is built (neonmap.json game).
_cut: The map's half width, metres (br.ts BR_HALF on SpeedKills): 152 since Phase 23.3, the owner's cut of the outer districts by about three quarters ("CUT DOWN ON THE OTSIDE DISTRICTS TOO BY LIKE 75% BC WE WANT IT TO BE FOCUSED IN THE MIDDLE NOW"), the 304 m the Neon City is laid out to.
_edge: The city's edge (Phase 20 A4; src/game/edge.ts, city.ts, main.ts edgeFrame). margin: how far past the edge a body can go before a wall stops it, metres: the owner's about 40, held to 38 because the range's covered lane ends 39 to 40 m north of the city (its back wall at world z 210 to 211, measured off the range's solids in a match), which keeps a body a metre off it. countdown: the owner's 5 s outside before the death; a step back in stops it and the next time out starts from 5 again. gulag: an out-of-bounds first death goes to the Gulag as a ring death does. There was a red laser down on whoever stayed, with a red ring on the ground round them, on every screen; the owner took it out, 2026-09-28 ("remove the laser stuff completely and just have the user die with the explanation"): a red circle kept being seen round enemies, and this was the one thing in the game that drew one on a figure.

fence._line: The fence's lit lines, a metre apart, each `line` 256ths of their 8 m texture high (6 cm; 3 until Milestone 668, 9 cm: from a roof beside the fence the lines over the eye ran off as wide red bands, the districts' review, picture 12).
fence._fade: Milestone 826 (the districts' sixth review: from THE STACKS' and THE WORKS' roofs 'pink and red fence wires fan across the sky', 'climb steeply like lasers'): the lines fade from `fade` of the fence's height (7 m) to nothing at its top, so over the eye of a body on a 10 to 12 m roof beside it they are gone and the fence still reads at the street.

_padSolve: A jump pad onto a roof (city.ts padOnto), in metres: it stands standOff past a body's radius from the face, throws you straight up to peakOver above the roof, and once you are clear above the edge carries you across to land landInside past it. Ours, so a pad lands you on the roof with no steering; holding forward in the air still carries you further.
_neonGlow: How bright the edge fence's posts and strips burn (world.ts buildEdgeFence), and the arenas' neon (arenas/build.ts): an emissive's intensity.
_atmosphere: The air over the map (atmosphere.ts): `margin` metres past the map's edge it still holds, `ease` seconds to blend to its colour. Its colours, near and far are the map's own (neonmap.json game.air).

atmosphere._climb973: Milestone 973 (the districts' eighth reviews, both readers: 'thin the haze at drop height', 'landing choices are made from there'): `climb`, the fog's near end rising `nearUp` a metre over `from` metres, so the ground under a falling player is out of it; `least` metres at the fewest from its near end to its far. `margin` 100 (40): the views from past the fence, under the firing range's 153 m, take the map's own air too.

_arenaLook: NEON BLOCK's walls (arenas/build.ts look "city"): the night facade texture's tile, metres, and its windows' glow.

bloom._note: The post chain's bloom (src/game/render.ts, Balanced and High): its strength, radius and luminance threshold. The owner, 2026-10-18: "bloom is a big thing, we don't want that almost at all". It was 0.32, 0.5 and 0.95: the tower's ceiling lamps, THE CANYON's walkway lamps and THE STRIP's club blew out to white, named in two reviews in a row. Now only the brightest light glows, faintly, and gunfire barely.

_skyline: A city past the fence (Milestone 680; both fresh reviews of 2026-10-20 found the edge 'a tabletop floating in beige haze', and asked first for a city carried on past the wall), drawn only (src/game/skyline.ts): the ground carried on from `from` metres past the fence (where the map's own ground ends) out to `ground`, and tower blocks on a jittered grid of `cell` m squares from `inner` (past the out-of-bounds margin, cut.half + edge.margin = 190, with room to spare) to `outer`, each square filled by `fill`, `size` m across, `height` m tall, low by the fence and rising toward the horizon (from the 50 m lookout an even ring stood as one wall over the map's own towers), `tall` of those past `tall.from` of the way out taller (all under the dropship's 140 m, squad.json ship.height); `setback` of the others carry a block `scale` as wide on top, `height` of their own height, for a skyline's broken line. Their windows are worked out in the shader, a storey `storey` m and a bay `bay` m, `lit` of them lit in `warm` or `cool`, glowing `glow.night` by night and `glow.day` by day, through the map's own haze, and the far ones taken by it faster (`haze`, of the fog's colour at `outer`). Each block wears one of `bodies`. `seed` the same skyline on every page. `keep` [x0, x1, z0, z1] map metres the towers and the ground stay out of: the firing range's footprint (its solids measured in the game, world x -34.5 to 123 and z -122 to 195, up to 60 m: map z -622 to -305), 10 m round; it stands 153 m past the fence inside the ring, and the first skyline stood towers in its lanes. Since round 9: from 245 m (215), and `keep` empty: the page draws only the side of the world the camera is on, so the range and the city never show together, and the hole cut for the range drew as 'a flat tan slab north of the map'.

skyline._low: The low blocks (Milestone 771; the districts' fourth review, 2026-10-24: past the fence 'a dark empty moat' made the map 'a model on a black table', worst at night): a jittered grid of `cell` metre squares from `from` metres out (past the out-of-bounds margin, the map's 150 and edge.margin 38, with 6 m to spare) to `inner`, each filled by `fill`, `size` metres a side and `height` tall, windows lit as the towers' are; the towers past `inner` stand where they stood (the low blocks draw from a random sequence of their own).
skyline._roads: The city's lit roads past the fence (Milestone 813; the districts' fifth review: 'put something visible in the dark band (a lit elevated road or a canal)', at night 'the moat is a black void'): a grid of lit lines `w` wide on the ground every `every` metres from `from` (past the fence) out to `to`, between the low blocks, in a street lamp's amber at `glow` by night and not drawn by day. Each line a row of lamps, `dash` metres long every `every` (drawn whole, the grid read from the air as a lit floor's lines, not as streets).
skyline._glow878: Milestone 878 (the districts' sixth review: 'halve its window light at night', 'the playable square is darker than the filler city round it'): the windows' night glow 0.6 (1.15).
skyline._groundDay884: Milestone 884 (the districts' seventh review: 'the black ground past the fence a pale road by day'): `groundDay`, the ground past the fence by day; by night `groundColour`, where the map's own lamps should be the light in view.
skyline._glow1062: Milestone 1062 (the districts' tenth reviews: 'at night the filler city brighter than the districts', 'dim the filler city at night'): the windows' night glow 0.3 (0.6, Milestone 878; 1.15 before). Measured off night-d99 (by a proposal agent): the districts, 100 to 152 m out, mean linear luminance 0.053 and their brightest hundredth over 0.392; the city past the fence, 190 to 400 m out, 0.037 and 0.438, so its windows outshone the map's lights though it was darker on the whole. With the windows' light halved (its pixels over its own 30th percentile scaled in linear light) its brightest hundredth is 0.225, 0.57 of the districts', its mean 0.45 of theirs; the lit roads (`roads`) stay at 0.9, the one thing the reviews said helped at night.
skyline._ring: Milestone 1062 (the districts' tenth reviews: 'a grey moat and neat rows of untextured boxes past the fence, a stage in a void', 'the edge part of the world: a raised highway or barrier wall'): a ring road round the map past the fence (src/game/skyline.ts), `from` to `to` metres from the middle: past the map's own ground (cut.half + `from`, 160 m) by 6 m, inside the out-of-bounds margin (190 m), where a body that walks out stands on it, and short of the low blocks (`low.from`, 194). Its asphalt `colour` measured: by day the overhead picture (d00-above) shows the moat's ground (`groundDay` #4a4d54) at sRGB 83,84,96 and the map's own ring road at 72,65,61; the light on the moat taken channel by channel in linear light (1.26, 1.20, 1.32), the colour that shows as the map's road is #403b35. `lines` its lane lines [metres in from its inner edge, dashed 0 or 1], `w` wide in `paint`, the dashes `dash.len` every `dash.every`: four lanes between whole edge lines, so from the drop the city ends on a road. The night's lit roads (`roads`) cross it where they did.
